nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom class on the wrapper div around the 'Type of commodity' select form-group
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Bespoke IPAFFS class, not part of the Design System. Likely just a JS/CSS hook for the commodity-type dependent behaviour (type options + species list are driven off the selected commodity code).
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: None needed - the underlying control is a standard govuk-select in a govuk-form-group; the hook can be dropped or replaced with a data attribute in the rebuild.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom wrapper class around the govuk-table giving it horizontal-scroll/responsive behaviour on small screens

nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: GOV.UK Table inside an overflow-x scroll container (standard pattern) if horizontal scroll is required; the summary here is only two columns so a plain govuk-table (or a Summary list) would suffice.

fields.name: type
fields.label: Type of commodity
fields.requiredEvidence: Not user-mandatory in the legacy handler. The type hierarchy is populated from commodity reference data and getSelectedId automatically takes an explicit selection, then a reference-data default, then the first option (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_commodity_attributes.js:298-326). The POST validator accepts type-id as Joi.any() and has no required rule for it (service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_commodity_attributes.js:10-31). If reference data supplies exactly one blank-labelled option, the template emits a hidden type value instead of a select (service/src/views/importer/consignmentCommodityAttributes.html:46-69).
fields.conditionalOn: Option list is derived from the selected commodity code — lamb (0204100010) offers only 'Domestic'; fish (03019230) offers 'Farmed stock' and 'Wild stock'; the default boneless code (020130) is driven with 'Farmed game'. This is reference data, not a fixed enum. For commodity code 96020000 the QA config supplies typeOfCommodity:'' and the workflow's if-guard skips selection; this proves that journey variant proceeds without filling the control, but does not independently prove whether the select is absent, empty, or optional.
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 24 confirms select 'type' has 1 option: 16=Domestic; trace db2d277c5c8bfcf2dc0f2278bc92dc7aa8fdf42d action 22 confirms 2 options: 20=Farmed stock and 61=Wild stock. Farmed game is source-only inferred from workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:127 and tests/accessibility/ched-p-accessibility-tests.spec.ts:48, so it is retained as an annotated option example but removed from observedValues. Label locator page-objects/notification/CommodityBasicDescriptionPage.ts:6; QA vocabulary types/commodity-type.ts:2-5; Domestic selection workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:686; Farmed stock selection workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:871; 96020000 empty configuration tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-auto-clearance.spec.ts:55 and selection guard workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:293.

fields.name: species
fields.label: Select species of commodity
fields.requiredEvidence: Conditionally mandatory when the commodity reference-data view model contains one or more species: the validator replaces species with Joi.any().required() and maps a missing CVEDP value to SPECIES (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_commodity_attributes.js:33-39). If the list is absent, no species rule/control applies; if the list is exactly one blank-labelled entry, the template submits it as a hidden value (service/src/views/importer/consignmentCommodityAttributes.html:122-183). This is frontend journey mandatoriness; CommodityComplement.speciesID has no model @NotNull (CommodityComplement.java:18-34).
fields.requiredNote: Required only when the selected commodity/category produces one or more selectable species.
fields.conditionalOn: The species checkbox list is derived from the selected commodity code — lamb (0204100010) shows only 'Ovis aries'; fish (03019230) shows 'Anguilla anguilla' and 'Anguilla spp.'; boneless (020130) is exercised with Bison spp. and Bibos spp. This is reference data (a species taxonomy), not a fixed enum. Multi-select. For commodity code 96020000 the QA config supplies species:'' and the workflow's if-guard skips selection; this proves that journey variant proceeds without filling a species control, but does not independently prove whether the checkboxes are absent, empty, or optional.
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 24 confirms 1 species option, Ovis aries (value 1736900); trace db2d277c5c8bfcf2dc0f2278bc92dc7aa8fdf42d action 22 confirms 2 species options, Anguilla anguilla (1729499) and Anguilla spp. (1756325). Bison spp. and Bibos spp. are source-only inferred from workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:128, tests/accessibility/ched-p-accessibility-tests.spec.ts:49 and tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-poe-validation.spec.ts:46, so they are retained as annotated option examples but removed from observedValues. Dynamic locator page-objects/notification/CommodityBasicDescriptionPage.ts:10; QA vocabulary types/species.ts:3-11; Ovis aries selection workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:687; Anguilla spp. selection workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:872; 96020000 empty configuration tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-auto-clearance.spec.ts:55 and selection guard workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:296.

validationMessages.message: Commodity lines must be fewer than 501
validationMessages.trigger: Adding the selected species would exceed the legacy maximum of 500 commodity lines on a non-CHEDPP notification, including CHED-P.
validationMessages.evidence: The handler calculates and submits exceedsMaxCommodityLines when species are posted (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_commodity_attributes.js:144-153). The validator maps true to MAX_COMMODITY_LINES for non-CHEDPP at service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_commodity_attributes.js:26-28; verbatim copy is asserted at service/test/validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_commodity_attributes_test.js:86-99.

openQuestions: RESOLVED FROM LEGACY: Type of commodity is not a user-mandatory selection because the handler defaults the hierarchy; species is required only when species options exist ('Select at least one species'); and addCommodity is required for CVEDP ('Select yes if you want to add another commodity') (validation/routes/handlers/importer/consignment_commodity_attributes.js:10-50; messages/en.js:42,141).

The 'Type of commodity' select and 'Select species of commodity' checkboxes are both dynamically populated from the selected commodity code (reference data). The new app must source these from a reference-data service keyed on commodity code, not hardcode them. The full taxonomy is not enumerable from the admissible evidence — only the lamb, fish and boneless-beef variants are captured.
CONFIRMED FROM LEGACY: choosing addCommodity='true' redirects back to the commodity selection page to add another commodity (routes/handlers/importer/consignment_commodity_attributes.js:188-195).

Hidden inputs present on the form (commodity-selected-code, commodityDetailsPage, typeButtonId, class/class-select-hidden, etag, complement-id, type-id, class-id, family-id, crumb, returnUrl, fromFooterHeader) are mostly IPAFFS state/CSRF plumbing. However, the legacy template also confirms Class of commodity and Family of commodity can be visible user selects when reference data provides meaningful options (consignmentCommodityAttributes.html:71-119); those two missed fields are now captured.

For commodity code 96020000, the CHED-P test supplies empty type and species values (tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-auto-clearance.spec.ts:55-57) and the generic workflow skips both controls (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:293-299). Legacy defines the rendering rule: type/class/family selects are replaced by hidden values for exactly one blank option, while species is hidden for exactly one blank entry (consignmentCommodityAttributes.html:46-125). The precise 96020000 reference-data response is still not captured.

Legacy policy point: species and addCommodity mandatoriness is enforced by frontend Joi, while CommodityComplement.speciesID/speciesType/speciesClass/speciesFamily carry no @NotNull annotations (CommodityComplement.java:18-46). The ValidationMessages.properties commodity-selection key at line 91 applies only to NotificationLowRiskFieldValidation via Commodities.java:149-155, not CHED-P. Preserve journey enforcement but revisit incomplete-draft policy separately.
